name: Hot Nudge

features.name: Hot Wilds
features.description: Four-high wilds that nudge to cover the reel.

features.name: Freespins
features.description: Seven spins with more Hot Wilds.

review:
One of the very first xNudge games – a steampunk 5x4 where you can see the studio's signature mechanic being born. Four-high Hot Wilds on reels 2 to 4 always nudge to cover their reel, and Hot Symbol Nudge pulls matching stacked premiums into view.

Three scatters give seven free spins with more Hot Wilds. Medium volatility, a 2,413x cap and 96.29% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
